summary: **QSR Automations (ConnectSmart KDS)** — Battery Ventures majority investment (Nov 2024); **merged with Crunchtime** (Jun 10, 2025) — combined 800+ brands, 150k+ locations, 100+ countries

**Presto** — voice AI; Nasdaq delisting & lender-led restructuring in 2024; SEC charged it over misleading AI statements; raised $10M (Jan 2026, led by Metropolitan Partners); Carl's Jr./Hardee's named customer; Toast integration announced Sep 21, 2026
**Omilia (Taco Bell)** — Taco Bell voice AI at ~900 US restaurants in 38 states (Jul 9, 2026)
**CKE history** — in 2023 CKE used Presto, OpenCity and Valyant for drive-thru AI; "significant rise in revenue due to the upsell capability" (Phil Crawford, CTO, re: Presto pilot)
